newsitem.title: UK: Gibbs Mew shares plunge as profits slashed.
newsitem.headline: Gibbs Mew shares plunge as profits slashed.

text.p: Shares in pub operator and brewer Gibbs Mew were 91-1/2p lower at 295p at 1200 GMT after the company announced a sharp fall in its half year profits on Monday.
Pretax profits fell to 0.96 million stg in the half year ended September 14, from 2.52 million over the same period in 1995.

"It's a very disappointing set of numbers. They really reflected unexpected exceptional costs, problems in part of their tenanted estate in the north and poor beer sales," said one analyst who chose not to be namded.
The company also warned its results for the second half were expected to improve but would still be disappointing in comparison with last year.
Its first half results reflected exceptional costs of 0.47 million stg for closing its Centric offices in April.
